DAVIS, Calif. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GLP-1 adoption is creating a new formulation challenge for America's food industry: delivering more nutrition in smaller portions without sacrificing taste, texture or affordability.
According to PwC, 21% of U.S. households included a current GLP-1 user in May 2026, up from 9% in January 2025. Circana finds 65% of GLP-1 users seek more protein, and BCG reports that 70% of users see eating or fitness habits change across their households. Demand extends beyond medication users, making mainstream reformulation critical.
Adding protein or fiber affects structure, taste, processing, stability and cost. Improving one target can undermine another, making trial-and-error development expensive.
